meta.name: codex-loop
meta.description: Fix Elixir/Phoenix code until Codex CLI review comes back clean — bounded review, fix, verify loop before opening a PR. Use when codex is installed and you want an external cross-model critic on your changes before pushing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重复审查-修复循环直到通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在提交PR前想确保代码通过严格审查
copy.tagline_en: Run review-fix loop until codex approves
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to pass codex review before opening a PR

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会使用 Codex CLI 对 Elixir/Phoenix 代码进行外部审查，然后根据审查结果自动修复问题，并验证修复是否通过编译和测试。重复这个过程直到审查清洁或达到最大轮数，最终生成报告。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /phx:codex-loop 命令，并且系统已安装 Codex CLI 时触发。通常用于准备提交 PR 之前的代码审查和修复。

say.text: 请用 /phx:codex-loop 审查并修复当前分支的代码。
say.note: Claude 会运行默认审查，修复发现的问题。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude uses Codex CLI to externally review Elixir/Phoenix code, then automatically applies fixes to approved findings, verifies via compilation and tests, and repeats until clean or max rounds reached. Outputs a final report.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the /phx:codex-loop command when Codex CLI is installed. Typically used before opening a pull request to review and fix code.

say_en.text: Run /phx:codex-loop to review and fix the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude runs default review and applies fixes.
Skips P3 suggestions, fixes high-priority issues automatically.
